title: 1. Subject & Action
prompt:
1. Subject & Action
A beautiful 23-year-old Japanese woman with pale porcelain skin, natural gray-blue eyes, extremely delicate and refined facial features, light fashionable dewy morning makeup. Voluptuous natural G-cup breasts with soft realistic droop and an extremely slim waist. She wears a loose light beige linen oversized shirt and high-waisted cream shorts. One hand is raised to adjust her slightly messy hair while the other holds a smartphone. She has just noticed the camera and gives a shy, embarrassed, slightly surprised smile.

2. Setting & Time
Early morning in a quiet Japanese urban residential alley. Background includes weathered walls, hanging laundry on a line, potted plants along the sidewalk, and everyday living traces. Soft slanted morning sunlight.

3. Composition & Camera
Candid street-style snapshot, slightly asymmetric documentary framing. Mid-shot to three-quarter view, natural standing pose. Feels like a stolen moment rather than a posed photograph.

4. Lighting & Style
Soft, natural, slanted morning sunlight creating gentle highlights and realistic skin texture. Contemporary youth fashion documentary style inspired by Fumi Nagasaka. Ultra-photorealistic, high-fashion quality mixed with authentic snapshot feel. 8k, hyper-detailed fabric texture and skin.

5. Constraints
No exposure, clothing stays in place, no vulgarity. Tasteful, high-end, natural and realistic. Emphasize body curves only through fabric drape and natural posture. Adult woman, 23 years old.
